turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Let me show you one first.
I have ___ pen. I look at "pen". It starts with a "p" sound, not a vowel sound. So I write "a": I have a pen.
Rule: use "an" before a vowel sound, and "a" before other sounds.
Right: She eats an apple. Wrong: She eats a apple.
Now you. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
